comparison.objective: Stand balusters along a guard so a 51 mm test ball cannot pass through any gap.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated upright placement and spacing against a gauge constraint.
comparison.success_condition: No gap admits the 51 mm ball; attachment, stability, and tolerance details are missing.
comparison.reason: This is spatial layout and gap compliance, not coaxial tool insertion followed by controlled fracture and fragment recovery.
